description: Source code for a development service in a Go project, implementing dev mode operations such as starting, stopping, and monitoring a development agent process, with capabilities to discover agent ports and display agent features.

classes.name: DefaultDevService
classes.description: Implementation of a development mode service managing agent processes, port discovery, and capability display.

methods.name: NewDevService
methods.description: Factory function to create a new DefaultDevService instance.

methods.name: RunInDevMode
methods.description: Starts the agent in development mode for a specified path with options.

methods.name: StopDevMode
methods.description: Stops the development mode agent process (not yet implemented).

methods.name: GetDevStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the dev server (not yet implemented).

methods.name: runDev
methods.description: Handles the process of starting the agent, port discovery, and displaying capabilities in dev mode.

methods.name: getFreePort
methods.description: Finds an available port in the range 8001-8999.

methods.name: isPortAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a specific port is available.

methods.name: startDevProcess
methods.description: Starts the agent process with environment setup, virtual environment detection, and process initiation.

methods.name: discoverAgentPort
methods.description: Discovers the port the agent is listening on by polling localhost.

methods.name: waitForAgent
methods.description: Waits until the agent responds as ready on a specified port (not used currently).

methods.name: displayDevCapabilities
methods.description: Fetches and displays agent's reasoners and skills.

methods.name: loadDevEnvFile
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a .env file in the package directory.
